run_debugger_test: run a Boost.Build debugger test by splitting stdin/stdout I/O and executing via the tester
split_stdin_stdout: split debugger session text into stdin commands and stdout output with regex pattern support
create_debugger_tester: create a BoostBuild.Tester instance configured for debugger testing with console debug flags
test_debugger_step_next: test the debugger step and next commands to verify line-by-line execution of Jam rules
test_debugger_breakpoints: test breakpoint creation, deletion, enabling, disabling, and clearing during debugger sessions
